property_summary: For any successful external payable call to C.fallback that sends exactly 10 ether, C.pastBlockTime after the call must be strictly greater than its previous value; the mutant removing the require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime) allows a successful call where pastBlockTime does not strictly increase (e.g., when block.timestamp is unchanged), violating this rule for some fuzzed inputs.
change_summary: Remove the require that block.timestamp > pastBlockTime so calls with non-increasing timestamps no longer revert.
